personal.name: Hemesh Gupta
personal.bio: Building resilient backend systems and cloud-native architectures. Currently shipping licensing infrastructure at Tableau, Salesforce.

about.headline: About
paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineer II at Salesforce, Bengaluru, building backend systems for Tableau Licensing Services. My work spans licensing infrastructure, user services, and cloud migrations, with a focus on reliability and scale.

I'm drawn to hard problems: distributed systems, AI infrastructure, and the kind of engineering which leaves an impact. Outside work, I build side projects and write about things I run into along the way.

experience.description: Started with Tableau Cloud Manager's User Service, building user lifecycle APIs, saga-based sync to Tableau Pods, bulk operations via Step Functions, and license consumption tracking on multi-region DynamoDB. Then moved to Tableau's Licensing team, working across different licensing services to ship activation, lease management, and freemium licensing.

Part of the Customer Growth & Engagement team. Built backend services powering cashback, referrals, and transactional flows that scaled to production traffic. Ktor, Dagger, clean APIs, and zero P0s across the internship.

Built a config drift detection pipeline for Tableau Cloud pods, pulling configs from GitLab repos and S3, diffing against the golden baseline, auto-filing GUS defects, and alerting teams on Slack. Fully automated, zero manual toil.

Automated a full regression suite using Selenium and Pytest, replacing hours of manual QA effort per cycle. Cut regression turnaround significantly and freed the team to focus on shipping instead of re-testing.

education.institution: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani
education.description: Graduated from the Pilani campus with a strong foundation in software development, problem-solving, and innovation — applied through coursework, side projects, and a from-scratch ERPLAG compiler.

projects.title: Real-Time Collaborative Editor
projects.description: A Google Docs-style editor with real-time multi-user collaboration using Socket.io and operational transforms to handle concurrent edits without conflicts.

projects.title: ERPLAG Compiler
projects.description: Complete compiler for ERPLAG in C: lexer, parser, semantic analyzer, and code generator. Written from scratch with no libraries, just pointer arithmetic and pain.

projects.title: chotu: URL Shortener
projects.description: A URL shortener service built with Spring Boot. Clean REST API, redirect tracking, and enough Spring annotations to make an enterprsie architect proud.

projects.title: ASCII Image Converter
projects.description: Converts any image into ASCII art. Supports a CLI tool and a Django REST API so you can make your photos look like a 1980s terminal. Deployed with proper WSGI and everything.

projects.title: Spring Boot E-Commerce API
projects.description: RESTful product catalog and shopping cart API with CRUD, image uploads, and keyword search. Uses an in-memory database that forgets everything on restart, just like me after meetings.

projects.title: Packet Sniffer
projects.description: A Java network tool for capturing and inspecting live traffic, with port scanning and basic traffic analysis. Written when I wanted to understand what was actually happening on the wire.

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.description: The site you're looking at right now. Built with React, Tailwind, and Framer Motion. Dark mode, smooth animations, and zero dependencies I didn't need.
